summary: Meta AI announced the public release of Muse Spark 1.3 max, a new variant within the Muse Spark 1.3 model line, claimed to show stronger coding and agentic performance than the existing high and xhigh variants.

practices.reason: The author claims meaningfully stronger coding and agentic performance versus sibling variants, but no benchmark figures are given, so this warrants investigation before switching production traffic.
practices.quote: we see significantly stronger coding and agentic performance on muse spark 1.3 max, so would strongly recommend trying it out even if you've already tried muse spark 1.3 high or muse spark 1.3 xhigh.
